heading: This Afternoon
text: Showers becoming more scattered, with a chance of isolated thunderstorms developing. Highs in the low to mid 70s, upper 70s in the warmest valleys. Light northeast wind.

heading: Tonight
text: Any storms ending, then showers diminishing west to east. Valley fog developing overnight. Lows in the 50s to near 60. Light north wind.

heading: Friday
text: Variable clouds and sun, with more sunshine developing in the afternoon. Chance of a few afternoon spotty showers. Highs in the 70s to low 80s. Light north wind.
